content.text: The baseline has three failures matching this issue. I’ll replace the legacy `update()` guard with explicit expired and exited checks, which will also fix `shift()`. I’ll add coverage for rescheduling after the `TimeoutError` leaves the context, exception-driven exits, and updating an exited timeout with no deadline.
